Nitin Sahrawat | Nitin Sahrawat (Born 13 August 1981), is an Indian television actor and a model.  He is best known for his Indian and Pakistani TV commercials and for his portrayal of Rajveer Singh Ahluwalia in "Kitani Mohabbat Hai Season 2" which was telecast on Imagine TV.  He is presently playing the character of Superstar Anand Kumar opposite Additi Gupta in ZEE TV's Qubool Hai.
Additi Gupta | Aditi Gupta (stylized as Additi Gupta) is an Indian actress, model and fashion designer, known for her work as the protagonist in the popular television series "Kis Desh Mein Hai Meraa Dil" on Star Plus channel. Mohit Sehgal | Mohit Sehgal is an Indian television actor.  He is best known for his role of Samrat Shergil in the Indian television series, "Miley Jab Hum Tum" on STAR One. Mohit has also participated in "Nach Baliye Season 8" with Sanaya in 2017 and they made it to the Finale.  Mohit is currently seen as Ayaan Mehta in Love Ka Hai Intezaar on Star Plus.
Deepak Wadhwa | Deepak Wadhwa is an Indian television actor.  He has performed many roles in various Hindi television shows, like Dhoondh Legi Manzil Humein, Kaali- Ek Punar Avtaar, Ishq Kills, Qubool Hai,Tamanna, Code Red.  As of July 2017, he has done his most recent role in Yeh Hai Mohabbatein.  He has also appeared in a cameo in Calender Girls.  He is known for playing lead role of Sanjay in Star Plus sports-drama "Meri Tamanna and Rahaat in Zee Tv's Qubool Hai"
Paaras Madaan | Paras Madaan is an Indian television actor who shot to fame with the television series Kis Desh Mein Hai Meraa Dil on Star Plus and later known for the roles in the shows like Nisha Aur Uske Cousins and Qubool Hai.
Dil Dhoondta Hai | Dil Dhoondta Hai is an upcoming Indian Hindi romantic drama television series, which is premiere sometime on 21 September 2017 and will be broadcast on Zee TV.  The series will be produced by Dashami Creations of Nitin Vaidya.  The series will be aired on weekdays' nights.  Stavan Shinde and Shivya Pathania will play the lead roles.
Disha Parmar | Disha Parmar (born November 11, 1994) is an Indian actress and model.  She's best known for her lead roles as Pankhuri in Star Plus's television series "Pyaar Ka Dard Hai Meetha Meetha Pyaara Pyaara" & As Jhanvi In Zee Tv's drama series Woh Apna Sa.
